q1: SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE beer IN (SELECT s.beer FROM serves AS s, frequents AS f WHERE s.bar = f.bar AND f.drinker LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY s.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.bar) >= 2) GROUP BY beer ORDER BY beer
q2: WITH t1 AS (SELECT bar FROM frequents WHERE drinker LIKE '%B%'), t2 AS (SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap FROM serves WHERE bar IN (SELECT bar FROM t1) GROUP BY beer), t3 AS (SELECT t2.beer, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM t2, serves WHERE t2.beer = serves.beer GROUP BY t2.beer) SELECT t2.beer, price_gap, avg_price FROM t2, t3 WHERE t2.beer = t3.beer
